discrepancies: child_process.md:2323 subprocess.timedOut has `added: v27.0.0-alpha.0.1.0`, a non-standard release string (from the 27.0.0 alpha release commit). Absent (undefined) in v26.13.0; present on main. Example header uses v27.0.0.
child_process.md:236 error.timedOut for exec()/execFile() callbacks has no YAML history; it is undefined in v26.13.0 and true on main.

cli.md:2747-2749 says a main thread that does not respond within two seconds makes Node.js 'exit immediately without printing the stack trace and resources'; behavior: it exits with 124 about 2 s after the timeout and prints 'The main thread did not respond within 2000ms. It is likely blocked in a synchronous native operation ...'. Consistent in substance; wording 'immediately' means after the 2 s grace.

cli.md:2764-2770 (node --test): not a contradiction, but the runner's own timeout always starts first, so it fires before any test-file child's and identifies the hung file only as 'ProcessWrap (pid N)'; the child's own summary is lost.
